text: Corporate Integrity Agreements are one form of dynamic governance that may be able to temporarily increase fiduciary duties as a form of quasi law.
citation: Kaal, A Comparative Perspective on the Limitations of the Duty of Oversight – A Comment on Lisa Fairfax (2013)
